title: M12 — PKI & TLS — Baseline
description: Tour a healthy PKI on the fleet: cert-manager and the internal CA (a SelfSigned bootstrap issuer, the CA Certificate, and the CA ClusterIssuer), a leaf Certificate reconciled into a kubernetes.io/tls Secret (decode it and read its SANs), an mTLS call between two workloads (config-client -> config-api), and certificate expiry + automatic renewal.

steps.title: A Certificate becomes a TLS Secret
